title: AgentTurn
description: One bounded turn in an embedded agent session. Carries the user or system message, bounded evidence references, plan references, tool call outputs and final outcome. Hidden chain-of-thought is never recorded here; the planner's scratchpad is ephemeral and lives only in the running session memory.

content.description: Outcome-first, concise message. Internal chain-of-thought is never stored here.

evidence_refs.description: Stable evidence IDs the turn inspected. Required so the conversation is auditable.

plan_ref.description: Optional reference to an AgentPlan that this turn advances.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls the assistant issued in this turn. Each call has a schema_hash from the capability registry; calls without a matching hash are rejected.
